what: Backlog item 6: a CPU smoke test that loads the champion serving bundle and scores a fixed set of about 50 public ISIC images (tests/test_champion_smoke.py). It skips, saying why, until both inputs below exist.

bundle_asset.note: the evaluated serving bundle (registry v1, model_gen v2) as a tar.gz attached to a GitHub release; the owner uploads it (decided 2026-11-03). Fill url and sha256 then.

images_note: written by scripts/make_smoke_manifest.py (needs the ISIC API, which this repo's cloud sessions cannot reach): isic_id, diagnosis, license, attribution, url, sha256. Images are fetched at test time and never committed.
max_abstain_share_why: the abstain threshold is the 95th percentile of the validation OOD score, so on in-distribution test images about 5% should abstain; 20% leaves room for 50 images and still fails a bundle whose detector is broken
